task: Section 31: which compiler invariants are genuinely necessary (every pass must preserve them), tested rather than assumed.

candidate_invariants_tested.invariant: semantic equivalence (isomorphism class is the unit of meaning, not the labeled instance)
candidate_invariants_tested.evidence: Every result in this project since run 1 is reported per isomorphism class; the orbit-stabilizer identity (class_size*|Aut(R)|=N!) has been verified with zero exceptions across 3160+ classes. Dropping this invariant would make every count in this project meaningless (raw labeled counts vs iso-class counts differ by orders of magnitude, e.g. 59088 raw vs 2462 classes at N=4).

candidate_invariants_tested.invariant: dependency equivalence (a pass may not silently reorder or skip a genuine dependency)
candidate_invariants_tested.evidence: This run's own central correction (kernel reconfiguration, uoc_compiler_kernel.json) was CAUSED by exactly this invariant being violated in the prior run (TH-ARBS-001B applied to the wrong object in the dependency chain) -- necessity demonstrated by the failure mode it prevents.

candidate_invariants_tested.invariant: admissibility (a filter's derivation status must travel with it, not be dropped after computation)
candidate_invariants_tested.evidence: Directly prevented a real error THIS run: an early draft of the active-filter set in UOC-C0-SEED-CANONICALITY-002 (visible in that run's own text) included a CONDITIONAL status filter among 'active' constraints, giving a false F_N^derived=0 at every N until the status discipline was re-applied.
Formally required by every isomorphism-class-based claim in this project; independently spot-checked (138/138 permutation trials, UOC-C0-SEED-CANONICALITY-002).

No conservation law has been derived by this compiler at any layer -- the invariant cannot be shown necessary or unnecessary because nothing downstream currently instantiates it. Retained in the IR schema (see uoc_compiler_ir.json) as a placeholder for when/if PASS-12+ close, not asserted as currently enforced.
No dimensionful quantity exists anywhere in the current kernel (pure combinatorics, N<=4 finite sets) -- same reasoning as conservation.

Explicitly audited every run since C-004C; formally re-audited this run (see uoc_target_independence.json) -- necessary by the project's own governing mandate, not merely a nice-to-have; violating it would invalidate every prior closure claim retroactively.

This run's own central finding (the Section 18 SOURCE CONFLICT) was only catchable because provenance (which document, which version, which audit status) was tracked per-claim rather than merged into a single undifferentiated 'the source says X.' Directly demonstrated necessary this run.

conclusion: 6 of 8 candidate invariants are DEMONSTRATED necessary (each has a concrete failure mode it prevents, cited above, not merely asserted). 2 (conservation, dimensional consistency) are NOT YET TESTABLE given the current closure frontier -- retained in the schema, not claimed as currently enforced, per the honesty discipline (do not claim a property is preserved by a pass that has never executed).
